status: Exact rational static-payoff and worst-spread-price certificates
assumptions: VIX_T>=0, finite second moment, each original native option expectation within archived native bid/ask, mean VIX in indicated interval around observed forward. Every payoff inequality checked globally, not just on a finite grid. These bounds need not be sharp.
scope: No dynamic model, time consistency, SPX consistency or full market feasibility theorem follows. No Lean certificate.
